newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: German RWE takes stake in Czech.
newsitem.headline: German RWE takes stake in Czech.

text.p: German utility RWE AG on Wednesday said it had purchased a 10.33 percent stake in Czech electrical utility Stredoceska Energeticka a.s. (SE).
RWE board member Klaus Bussfeld told a news conference that RWE bought the stake from the firm Atlas, but did not disclose any further details of the transaction.
Bussfeld also told journalists that RWE has already begun construction of a heating plant for Skoda Auto in the town of Mlada Boleslav, 60km northeast of Prague.
RWE is part of a consortium, which also includes German energy firm OBAG Energie Versorgung AG, SE, and VW Kraftwerke GmbH, a subsidiary of car maker Volkswagen AG.
SE supplies electricity to some 429,000 households and over 196,000 companies in central Bohemia.
